title: Flourless Oat and Blueberry Pancakes
excerpt: Enjoy fluffy, nutritious pancakes made without wheat flour. A delicious, easy option for your mornings, full of the sweet flavor of fresh blueberries.
imageAlt: Stack of golden oat pancakes decorated with whole fresh blueberries and a touch of honey on a ceramic plate.
steps: Blend the rolled oats for a few seconds until processed into a texture similar to fine flour.
Add the egg, milk, baking powder, vanilla, cinnamon and the pinch of salt to the blender. Blend again until smooth and lump-free.
Let the batter rest for 5 minutes so the oats absorb the liquid and thicken slightly.
Heat a non-stick skillet over medium heat and melt a touch of butter to grease the surface.
Pour portions of the batter to form small discs in the pan. Immediately scatter a few whole Fresh Pick blueberries over the hot batter of each pancake.
Cook for 2 to 3 minutes until bubbles appear on the surface. Carefully flip the pancakes and cook for 1 to 2 more minutes until golden on both sides.
Serve the pancakes piping hot in a stack and decorate with the rest of the fresh blueberries on top.
tips: Fresh Pick blueberries, grown above 2,800 meters in Guasca, stand out for their firm texture that bursts gently when you bite into the hot pancake, adding an unmatched natural sweetness.
To keep leftovers, let the pancakes cool completely, store them in an airtight container in the fridge and reheat for a few seconds in a skillet or toaster to bring back their freshness.
